column1: # Readings with an unambiguously correct conversion, for measuring whether
# Everyday phrases whose right answer nobody would argue about. The point is not
# to score the converter — its starting accuracy is whatever it is — but to
# count how many of these it gets right *before* training and *after*, so that
# "an unrelated reading changed" can be split into "improved" and "broke".
# Deliberately unrelated to corpus-sample.txt and to anything the harness
# confirms, so a change here is leakage rather than the feature working.
